summary_paragraph: A woman with type 1 diabetes, end-stage renal disease, and a history of recent Klebsiella UTI was admitted for body twitching lasting 24 hours. She reported a prior similar episode with gabapentin and had recently been restarted on it for neuropathy. Labs showed elevated glucose but no uremia or infection signs. Gabapentin was discontinued, and she underwent scheduled hemodialysis, after which symptoms resolved. Asymptomatic bacteriuria was noted but not treated due to recent antibiotic completion and lack of symptoms. She was discharged home with instructions to avoid gabapentin and follow up with her primary care provider.
